privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Architecture
privacyPolicy.subtitle: Transparent, local-first, and security-hardened.
privacyPolicy.manifestoTitle: Manifesto: Your data is NOT our product.
privacyPolicy.manifestoText: YT Deluxe is engineered to be invisible. We believe media consumption should be a private act of freedom.
privacyPolicy.q1Text: We collect minimal data necessary for functionality: YouTube URLs you submit, selected quality preferences, and your download history tracking (optional). We do NOT collect personal identification, IP addresses for tracking, or browsing behavior.
privacyPolicy.q2Text: Data is collected solely to process your requests. History is tracked to help you manage your downloads, and preferences are stored so you don't have to re-configure settings on every visit.
privacyPolicy.q3Text: Your data stays with you. On Web, we use browser "localStorage". On Windows Desktop, we use a local JSON file in your user directory (~/.yt-deluxe/). Media files are processed in ephemeral server folders and auto-deleted after delivery.
privacyPolicy.firstPrinciple: We operate under the Sovereignty First principle. You own the metadata, you own the storage.
privacyPolicy.zeroExfiltration: Zero-Exfiltration: Browser history stays in localStorage. It never touches our servers.
privacyPolicy.localFiles: Local Files: Windows users have full visibility of download_history.json in their home directory.
privacyPolicy.noAnalytics: No Analytics: We value your focus; no tracking pixels, cookies, or heatmaps are used. ever.
privacyPolicy.ephemeral: Our processing engine follows a strict Ephemeral Lifecycle. Media components exist only as long as the download pulse is active.

about.architectureDesc: Built for those who demand more than just a download button.
about.visionText1: YT Deluxe was born from a simple necessity: the modern web requires a resilient, uncompromising tool for media preservation. In an era of ephemeral content, having a local, high-fidelity archive isn't a luxury it's essential.
about.visionText2: This system isn't just a wrapper; it's a dedicated engine. Every component, from the glassmorphic interface to the concurrent download daemon, is engineered to balance aesthetic beauty with raw technical capability.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.subtitle: Usage guidelines and legal framework for YT Deluxe.
terms.eulaDesc: Please read these terms carefully before using YT Deluxe.
terms.acceptanceText1: By downloading, installing, or using YT Deluxe, you agree to be bound by these terms. If you do not agree to these terms, do not use the application.
terms.acceptanceText2: YT Deluxe is provided "as is", intended strictly for educational, research, and non-commercial media preservation.
terms.fairUseDesc: Users are solely responsible for the content they download.
terms.fairUseText: You agree to respect the intellectual property rights of content creators. This tool must not be used to bypass DRM, distribute copyrighted material commercially, or violate the terms of service of any supported platform.

aboutUs.visionText1: YT Deluxe was born from a simple necessity: the modern web requires a resilient, ad-free, and uncompromising tool for media preservation. In an era of ephemeral content and complex downloaders, having a clean, high-fidelity archive isn't a luxury it's essential.
aboutUs.visionText2: Engineered as a full-stack solution using React and FastAPI, this platform seamlessly integrates the world-class yt-dlp core with a professional "Liquid Glass" interface. Our mission is to provide an ad-free, secure, and feature-rich experience for learners and creators alike.
aboutUs.feat1Desc: Supports resolutions from 144p up to 8K, with automatic FFmpeg merging for superior quality.
aboutUs.feat2Desc: No tracking, no user data collection, and all processing is handled transparently.
aboutUs.feat3Desc: Cut exactly what you need with precision trimming without any quality loss.
aboutUs.feat4Desc: Runs seamlessly as a web app or as a native Windows desktop application.
aboutUs.devDesc: Passionate about architecting high-performance, aesthetically stunning systems. YT Deluxe represents a fusion of technical robustness and premium "Liquid Glass" design, focusing on user experience, scalability, and security.
aboutUs.footerBanner: Non-Commercial • Educational Purpose Only • Open Source
aboutUs.footerText: © 2026 YT Deluxe. Engineered by Utsav Parmar. Built with React & yt-dlp.

termsCond.heroSubtitle: Legal framework for ethical digital consumption.
termsCond.g1Desc: YT Deluxe is Free & Open Source. We encourage transparency, community contribution, and ethical usage of technical tools.
termsCond.g2Desc: We respect YouTube community guidelines and terms of service. This tool is designed to work within metadata extraction limits.
termsCond.g3Desc: This platform is created for non-commercial and educational use. Use it to learn about media processing and full-stack development.
termsCond.mutualAgreementDesc: By utilizing the YT Deluxe Engine, you enter a mutual agreement to uphold these standards. This utility is provided as-is, representing a collaborative effort in open-source engineering.
termsCond.nonCommercialDesc: Strictly for private research and personal media archiving. No commercial redistribution.
termsCond.respectCreatorsDesc: Integrity of intellectual property is paramount. Always honor and support original creators.
termsCond.disclaimerText1: "This free, open-source tool is strictly for non-commercial, educational purposes. We respect YouTube Community Guidelines and creator intellectual property. Please use responsibly."
termsCond.disclaimerText2: The software is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind, express or implied. In no event shall the architects or contributors be held liable for any claim, damages or other liability arising from technical interactions with third-party service providers.
